objective: A single unreproduced indicator goes to review rather than stopping the release
preconditions: a new High finding at Low confidence
expected: REVIEW, not FAIL. A gate that stops a release on one unreproduced signal gets switched off, and then nothing is gated at all
detail: REVIEW: Only 2 of 5 configured check(s) executed. A result from a partial scan describes the part that ran and nothing else. 1 new finding(s) at or above High rest on a single unreproduced indicator. A person should look rather than the build stopping.
